paper.title: LongSpace: Exploring Long-Horizon Spatial Memory from Perception to Recall in Video

evidence.paraphrase: first room-tour video benchmark targeting long-horizon spatial memory from perception to recall; complements EgoSchema and VideoWebArena with an explicitly spatial axis

rationale.SM: Direct: remembered layouts, relations, locations, and routes are required by scored room-tour questions.
rationale.OS: Direct: 285 State Change questions test updated object/scene state across limited camera views; Figure 14 compares a door before and after opening.
rationale.TS: Partial: route planning/recall concerns navigation sequences, but no goal execution, task-completion state, or ongoing progress protocol is scored.
rationale.SC: Direct: the explicitly scored State Change subtask supplies direct capability evidence; persistent model-memory mutation is not implied.
